name: Lightbox
label: Lightbox
description: Fullscreen media viewer on the shared overlay stack: deep scrim, caption chip, gallery stepping, trapped and restored focus.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the lightbox requests to close

props.name: src
props.description: The image to show. Omit it when `children` supplies the media.

props.name: alt
props.description: Image alt text — also the panel's accessible name. Required whenever `src` is set.

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional caption shown in a chip under the media

props.name: children
props.description:
Custom media instead of `src` — a framework image component, a video, a
live embed. Sized by the same viewport bounds the plain image gets.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether ESC, backdrop click, and the close button can dismiss

props.name: onPrev
props.description:
Steps to the previous item. Providing it renders the previous chevron and
arms the Left arrow key — the consumer owns the collection and the index.

props.name: onNext
props.description: Steps to the next item — the next chevron and the Right arrow key.

props.name: viewerLabel
props.description: The panel's accessible name when neither `alt` nor `caption` is set.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous button, shown with `onPrev`.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next button, shown with `onNext`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the portal container, not the panel
